title: Entanglement and Complexity: Gravity and Quantum Mechanics
summary: Leonard Susskind lectures at Stanford on how gravity and quantum information theory have merged into a new way of thinking about physics. He covers entanglement and complexity, with applications from black holes to strange metals and the foundations of quantum mechanics.
why: Commenters recommend it as a clear, characteristically engaging Susskind lecture for people trying to grasp the entanglement and gravity connection.

quote.text: Mr.Susskind has a Stanford lecture on this topic detailing the physics in his own unique & awesome way
